skills.name: Tribute

steps.text: When not in Another Force, if another party member has used a magic attack this turn: Tribute takes that attack's Element and 2x the skill multiplier of its last hit (strength conditionals included, increase damage conditionals ignored)

skills.notes: Replaces the basic attack when not in Another Force — v0 은 AF 가 없어 늘 대체

skills.name: Miracle Form

need.text: When not in Another Force and AF gauge at 10%+ (consume 10% of AF gauge)

steps.text: When Miracle Form activates: restore 100% HP and 100% MP to user
After each user action 10% of current MP is consumed (any skill incl. basic attack; unaffected by MP cost change; also in AF). End of Turn with MP <50%: Miracle Form ends

skills.notes: 원문 Miracle Form 항목은 상태 설명이고 발동은 Time To Try! — AF 게이지가 형식 밖이라 text 조건. 효과(INT/SPR +250, [skill multipliers] x1.5)는 states 정의에. 지속은 MP 50% 미만 종료라 perm 으로 둠

skills.name: Stream Glare

steps.text: Water type magic attack on all enemies (XL): consume 10% of current MP (Max 100 MP; unaffected by MP cost change, consumed even in AF); skill multiplier = 30% x [consumed MP] (Max 3000% x MOD)
When in Miracle Form: Guaranteed critical, ignores target's defense (MDef=0); [consumed MP] taken from current MP after the Miracle Form -10%

skills.notes: 배율이 소모 MP 에 비례(30%/MP, 최대 3000%, 위키 0~3000) — 형식에 MP 변수가 없어 배율을 정할 수 없음 → 공격을 other 로 둠. 원문 예: MP 656 → Miracle Form 후 591 → 59 소모 → 1770%

skills.name: Time To Try!
skills.notes: Mental Focus: Magic damage of user +0.23% x MaxMP (CAP +250% at 1087MP+). Miracle Form 발동은 별도 trigger(on_use:Time To Try!)

notes: Miracle Form 은 AF 게이지 10%+ 가 조건이라 v0(AF 없음)에서는 발동 안 됨 — 실전에서는 거의 늘 켜지는 핵심 상태라 v0 결과는 과소
Miracle Form 의 INT · SPR +250 은 states.per 에 flat 으로 적었으나 엔진 v0 은 state per 의 대미지 배율만 읽는다
Stream Glare(최대 3000%) · Tribute 복사 · Miracle Form MP 소모는 형식 밖
